name: canvas
description: MSVC-free stub replacing node-canvas (native). pdfjs-dist lists canvas as an OPTIONAL dependency for PDF-to-image RENDERING; FinTrace only does TEXT extraction (getTextContent) and pre-stubs DOMMatrix/Path2D, so the real module is never needed — but its presence makes @electron/rebuild attempt a node-gyp/MSVC compile at package time. Applied via the `overrides` field in the root and backend package.json.
